notes: Azure 定价页当前列出的 model-router 费用为 input only，每 1M tokens 0.14 USD。
model-router 总费用需要再叠加实际路由到底层模型的 input/cache/output 成本。

There is no router-wide contextWindow, maxInputTokens or maxOutputTokens: the effective budget depends on the selected backend model. vision, tool and structured-output capabilities vary by route and are not guaranteed for every request.
The $0.14/1M input rate applies only to the published router SKU in its listed regions. Underlying model charges are separate and region/deployment dependent.
maxInputTokens, maxOutputTokens remain independently unverified for this exact deployment/endpoint. No token ceiling is inferred from a sibling model, billing unit, or subtraction of other limits.

protocolProfiles.chat/completions.reasoning.levels, protocolProfiles.chat/completions.reasoning.default, protocolProfiles.responses.reasoning.levels, protocolProfiles.responses.reasoning.default depend on the selected backend model and have no single fixed router-wide value. Client controls remain passthrough; no family default is invented.
pricing.outputPer1mTokens is inapplicable to the input-only router fee, not an unverified zero rate. The routed model's input/cache/output prices are accounted for separately.
